Searched Accountable dashboard API, Apyx STRC collateral page, and Wolf monthly securities attestations (Mar–Jun 2026); none state a WAM.

creditQuality.basis: apyUSD is an ERC-4626 vault whose sole asset is apxUSD; economic credit risk is pass-through to Preference Foundation’s DAT preferred-equity stack. Re-opened Accountable API 2026-07-27T22:45:43.737Z: collateralization 0.922477 (sub-100%), net −18.47M USD, redemption_value 0.9155, STRC 189.09M of 308.60M gross reserves (~70% of inventory-net reserves) vs Cash & Equivalents only 30.73M. Independent TID Research apxUSD/apyUSD reports document the June 2026 depeg (apxUSD trough ~$0.82, attested CR ~84%) and ~74% net STRC concentration after inventory netting — measured credit/mark shortfall, not absence of evidence. Preferred equity is junior to DAT indebtedness (Apyx risk docs; STRC ranking page).

seniority.basis: Underlying STRC is Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock: senior to common (and junior preferreds STRK/STRD) but junior to existing/future indebtedness and to senior preferreds such as STRF (Apyx STRC collateral docs). apyUSD holders hold vault shares redeemable for apxUSD, not a senior secured claim on the securities. Dual pin: Apyx STRC ranking section + Strategy SEC 424B5 / product description of perpetual preferred stock.

legalEnforceability.basis: Apyx Terms of Service §1.4 state Protocol-Generated Assets (including apyUSD) 'represent programmatic claims against the respective Protocol modules holding certain assets' and 'do not represent a claim against any particular entity or person'; §14 disclaims customary legal meanings of deposit/redeem/collateral terminology; BVI Preference Capital / Preference Foundation structure with mandatory arbitration. Dual pin: ToS text + TID Research naming Preference Foundation (Carolyn Kelly) as Wolf attestation signer and noting separation from Nasdaq-listed DFDV. No bankruptcy-remote fund share or regulated trust deed identified for apyUSD holders.

valuationCadence.basis: Independent AICPA examination-level monthly attestations by Wolf & Company, P.C. (Boston) for Mar/Apr/May/Jun 2026, re-opened as PDFs: June report dates 6/17 and 6/30/2026 (securities only — STRC/STRCx/SATA at Alpaca and on-chain STRCx; opinion letter dated July 22, 2026); May 5/5 & 5/31; April 4/9 & 4/30 (securities-only narrowing from March full-asset scope). Corroborated by Apyx third-party attestation index listing the same four monthly engagements and by Accountable live TEE dashboard (interval=live). Meets evidence-standard 'adequate' (dated independent attestation, monthly > quarterly). Note: April+ scope excludes cash/stablecoin components, so cash sleeve valuation is dashboard/issuer-only after 2026-03-31.

maturityAndLiquidity.basis: Dominant sleeve STRC is perpetual preferred (no maturity) — dual: Apyx STRC page ('Strategy’s perpetual preferred stock') and Strategy product/SEC materials describing Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock. Cash & Equivalents buffer is thin (~11% of inventory-net reserves on Accountable pin). Apyx risk docs state DAT preferreds are less liquid than T-bills and spreads can widen under stress; June 2026 depeg (TID) demonstrated exit/liquidity stress. apyUSD unlock is asynchronous (ERC-7540-style 3–20 day fee window per product docs), so maturity/liquidity risk includes both perpetual collateral and delayed vault exit.

custody.basis: Wolf June 2026 attestation names marketable preferred equity held with Alpaca brokerage in Preference Foundation (or subsidiary) name and STRCx in self-custodied on-chain wallets; dual pin Wolf PDF securities breakdown + Apyx Accountable dashboard docs (brokerage/exchange/wallet connectors; AWS Nitro enclave PoR). Institutional brokerage + named third-party PoR connectors, but not a regulated fund custodian (e.g. BNY) with bankruptcy-remote segregation for token holders; STRCx self-custody Safe is operator-controlled. Grade limited, not adequate.

recovery.basis: Documented structural recovery weakness: (1) ToS deny entity-level claim and cap Company liability; (2) Apyx risk docs state DAT preferred recovery in bankruptcy may be limited or nonexistent (preferred junior to debt); (3) Capitalization Framework wind-down distributes Total Collateral Value pro-rata without a senior secured recovery waterfall for apyUSD. Dual pin: ToS §1.4/§10 + risk-management page; corroboration TID (no atomic on-chain redemption of apxUSD to dollars; recovery depends on off-chain STRC liquidation). Not graded weak merely from missing docs — these are affirmative negative disclosures.
